attributeDescriptions.name: intent
attributeDescriptions.description: The user's intent. Exactly one lowercase word: 'prescription' (meds, dose, frequency, refills), 'stock' (inventory / stock levels / reorder), 'billing' (bills, charges, cost owed), 'patient' (patient details: diagnosis, ward, bed, allergies, admission), 'indent' (daily indent status, dispensed vs pending per ward), 'drug' (drug catalogue: strength, form, price), else 'general'.

attributeDescriptions.name: patientMrn
attributeDescriptions.description: Patient MRN / medical record number if mentioned, else empty string.

attributeDescriptions.name: drugName
attributeDescriptions.description: Drug or medication name if mentioned, else empty string.

attributeDescriptions.name: kind
attributeDescriptions.description: Turn type, one lowercase word. 'confirm' = user agrees to the pending action shown (yes/ok/sure/confirm/do it) — only when a pending action is present. 'cancel' = user rejects it (no/cancel/stop) — only when a pending action is present. 'action' = user asks to perform a write: restock inventory, or register/admit a new patient. Otherwise 'query' (a lookup question).

attributeDescriptions.name: action
attributeDescriptions.description: When kind is 'action', the action name: 'restock' or 'create_patient'. Else empty string.

attributeDescriptions.name: drug
attributeDescriptions.description: Drug/medication name to restock (when action=restock). Else empty.

attributeDescriptions.name: qty
attributeDescriptions.description: Quantity of units to add to stock (when action=restock). Else 0.

attributeDescriptions.name: name
attributeDescriptions.description: New patient full name (when action=create_patient). Else empty.

attributeDescriptions.name: dob
attributeDescriptions.description: New patient date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD (create_patient). Else empty.

attributeDescriptions.name: gender
attributeDescriptions.description: New patient gender: Male, Female, or Other (create_patient). Else empty.

attributeDescriptions.name: phone
attributeDescriptions.description: New patient phone number (create_patient). Else empty.

attributeDescriptions.name: wardCode
attributeDescriptions.description: Ward code the patient is admitted to, e.g. 'Ward 4A' (create_patient). Else empty.

attributeDescriptions.name: admissionDate
attributeDescriptions.description: Admission date as YYYY-MM-DD (create_patient). Else empty.

inputs.query:
SELECT p.dose, p.frequency, p."foodTiming", p."durationDays", p.notes,
       pat.name AS patient, pat.mrn AS mrn, d.name AS drug, d.strength
FROM "Prescription" p
JOIN "Patient" pat ON pat.id = p."patientId"
JOIN "Drug" d ON d.id = p."drugId"
WHERE p.status = 'active'
  AND ($1::text IS NULL OR $1 = '' OR pat.mrn = $1)
ORDER BY p."prescribedAt" DESC
LIMIT 50;

inputs.query:
SELECT di."indentDate", w.name AS ward, di.status,
       COUNT(il.id) AS total_lines,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE il.status = 'dispensed') AS dispensed,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE il.status = 'pending')   AS pending
FROM "DailyIndent" di
JOIN "Ward" w ON w.id = di."wardId"
LEFT JOIN "IndentLine" il ON il."indentId" = di.id
GROUP BY di.id, w.name, di."indentDate", di.status
ORDER BY di."indentDate" DESC
LIMIT 50;

inputs.query:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT action, params FROM "ChatbotPendingAction"
  WHERE "sessionId" = $1 AND "createdAt" > now() - interval '5 minutes'
),
res AS (
  SELECT CASE p.action
    WHEN 'restock' THEN sql_restock(p.params->>'drug', (p.params->>'qty')::bigint, false)
    WHEN 'create_patient' THEN sql_create_patient(
      p.params->>'name', p.params->>'dob', p.params->>'gender', p.params->>'phone',
      p.params->>'wardCode', p.params->>'bed', p.params->>'admissionDate',
      p.params->>'diagnosis', p.params->>'allergies', false)
  END AS j
  FROM p
),
del AS (
  DELETE FROM "ChatbotPendingAction" WHERE "sessionId" = $1
)
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT j->>'summary' FROM res), (SELECT j->>'error' FROM res), 'Nothing to confirm — that request may have expired.') AS reply;

inputs.query:
WITH r AS (SELECT sql_restock($1, $2::bigint, true) AS j),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO "ChatbotPendingAction"("sessionId", action, params, summary, "createdAt")
  SELECT $3, 'restock', jsonb_build_object('drug', $1::text, 'qty', $2::bigint), r.j->>'summary', now()
  FROM r WHERE (r.j->>'ok') = 'true'
  ON CONFLICT ("sessionId") DO UPDATE
    SET action = EXCLUDED.action, params = EXCLUDED.params,
        summary = EXCLUDED.summary, "createdAt" = now()
)
SELECT CASE WHEN (r.j->>'ok') = 'true'
            THEN (r.j->>'summary') || '. Confirm? (yes/no)'
            ELSE (r.j->>'error') END AS reply
FROM r;
